description.p: Neoism is a hardware-accelerated terminal-first workspace for code, notes, agents, and multiplayer editing.
It includes a GPU terminal, Rust-owned IDE chrome around managed Neovim, file tree, buffer tabs, command palette, diagnostics, finder, and agent terminal tabs.

Key features:
Live CRDT collaborative editing
Agent-driven code changes with LSP integration
Markdown notes with vaults and graph views
Native Rust LSP, diff panels, and Warp-style UI
Restores workspace and Explorer directory following when the first terminal changes directory. Servo runtime remains excluded.
Nightly Agent UI and frame-pacing improvements, live workspace search lifecycle fixes, streaming text reveal, and Codex usage inspection. Visible animations are preserved.
Fixes the Windows release-only Lua startup abort by preserving error unwinding, and adds release-executable Lua regression coverage.
YOLO stable release: fixes a Windows startup stack overflow during graphics adapter enumeration with an 8 MiB desktop main-thread stack reserve.
Substantial improvements to dev/release scripts, added AppStream metadata enhancements, better cross-platform support prep, and open-source readiness updates (MIT LICENSE, no Claude attribution).
